source.title: New Avalon
source.description:
As you've seen, New Avalon boasts a significant military presence but it also offers safety and security to civilians.

If you can cobble together a more permanent disguise, consider offering a helping hand. Ingratiating yourself with the folk there could be beneficial to our efforts to reclaim the enclave, to say nothing of putting you in a position to "appropriate" some of the material and resources there, enriching yourself and depriving their war machine of crucial supplies.
source.objective:
Use the Scarlet Insignia once you have acquired enough disguise pieces to fool the Scarlet Crusaders in New Avalon and speak with Inquisitor Jociphine again. Players with armor crafting professions can utilize recipes and plans for scarlet armor pieces obtained from hostile crusaders in Tyr's Hand and New Avalon.

Provided item:
source.progress: If you are having trouble acquiring the pieces you need via crafting them yourself, perhaps strike a trade with others who have the proper skills and access to suitable designs and patterns.
source.completion:
Convincing enough, I suppose.

New Avalon lost some of its master craftsmen during a caravan run to Hearthglen a few years back, but I can see some of their designs were not lost.

If you haven't honed your own tradeskills much, you may have a harder time making headway in New Avalon. However, regardless or whether you know how to work a hammer or a needle, I suspect you may want to at least pay a visit to the quartermaster in the barracks. You might also be able to rummage around their storeroom.
